intent: Identify and resolve partial screen flickering issue during video playback.
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to latest version (510.04.02) and reboot.
Roll back graphics driver to previous version (NVIDIA GeForce 527.90.11) and try again.
Run a stress test on the graphics card using tools like FurMark or Unigine Heaven.
Check for any software conflicts or updates that may be causing the issue.
